main_text.head: Pauca,
main_text.p: a. Inediam, nempe si decens nutritio defecerit, deficient & superflua.
b. Exercitationes, nempe per eas attenuantur su perfluitates, & per occultas uaporationes descen- dunt, & ita pauca redduntur contenta.
c. Obstructiones, nempe sola tenuia transeunt, & crassa adhærent.
d. Coctionis tarditas pauca reddit contenta ex causa manifestiore.
main_text.head: Multa,
main_text.p: Nempe si alimenta abundauerint, ualeatq; concoctrix facultas, multa coquentur, multaq; erunt superflua.
main_text.head: Tenuis,
main_text.l: a. Caloris natiui in tertia concoctione debilitatem.
b. Crudorum humorum tenuationem robora ta genuina caliditate.
main_text.p: a. Caloris debilitatem, ob frigiditatem, ita ut contenta ad mediocritatem peruenire non possint.
b. Crudorum humorum tenuationem, cum sci- licet

page.notes: Catchword-like marks absent. Greek and some italic words are read as printed; "ta genuina" and "robora" are reproduced as set. Faint marks at the top right are show-through and were left out.
